newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Chinese firm sets up in Nigeria's export zone.
newsitem.headline: Chinese firm sets up in Nigeria's export zone.

text.p: China's Golden Giant Industries is setting up a textile processing factory in Nigeria's export processing zone, Chinese embassy officials said on Friday.

They said Golden Giant was one of several Chinese companies expected to establish their presence in the export processing zone (EPZ) in Calabar, southeastern Nigeria, following agreements reached between the two countries last month when Prime Minister Li Peng visited Nigeria.

Local newspapers reported on Thursday that both nations had agreed that the Chinese should set up firms in the EPZ to process agricultural raw materials, timber and petroleum products for export to China to reduce its huge trade surplus with Nigeria.
But one Chinese embassy official in Lagos said, "Golden Giant Industries is so far the only Chinese firm setting up in the EPZ."

Since relations between Nigeria and the West became frosty over alleged human rights abuses by Nigeria's military government, Sino-Nigerian relations have warmed as Nigeria has turned to the East for new friends.
A Chinese firm has been dredging the waterway into the EPZ port while the revitalisation of Nigeria's dilapidated railways is also being handled by the Chinese, at a cost of $520 million.
China's state oil firm has also set up in Nigeria, ready to begin oil exploration and production activities in Africa's leading oil producing nation.
